requirements.title: Smart-Select -> Classify -> Contextual Edit
requirements.description: A built-in region-grow segment op + heuristic region classification feed a canvas selection tool that snaps to a region's silhouette, classifies the selected region, and offers a context-specific edit menu that compiles to an inpaint / object_removal / instruction-edit {mask + prompt}. A model-backed SAM path (mobilesam/sam-2.1/hq-sam, seeded) is the documented accuracy upgrade. Keyboard and file-upload fallbacks (auto-select + X/Y coordinate inputs) are preserved so no operation is pointer-only.

validation.notes: Built-in region-grow segmenter: point/box/auto modes produce a silhouette-snapped mask at source resolution, deterministic, tolerance widens the region, the service classifies + attaches the contextual menu, and a model override falls back to the built-in with a warning (no vaporware SAM claim).

Heuristic region classifier: position + colour + saturation + skin-tone + border-contact map a region to person/sky/foliage/background/object. Skin detection is tone-only (never identity/face recognition, a hard non-goal).

Contextual-edit compiler: every menu edit references an existing AI op, whole-image background_removal does not require the mask, requires-prompt edits carry completable hints, and an unknown class falls back to the generic object menu.

SelectionService segment edge end to end: multipart image + SegmentParams -> stored mask blob + classified region + menu + recorded job; missing image -> 400, invalid params -> 400, point mode without a seed -> 422.

Smart-Select surface: load image -> auto/coordinate select (no-pointer fallbacks) -> classify -> contextual menu; a no-prompt edit applies as a masked AI submit, a requires-prompt edit fills its instruction, and a 409 surfaces as an actionable backend gate, not an opaque failure.
